I really liked this game. It has a cute girl with nice expressions. (very important!) The last level was a bit of a surprise and I only beat it because it got incredibly lucky with one of my rolls. Best win-strat for me was: [spoiler]happy + yacht with twos, you can just stack the +mult effects of the "contains three of a kind", "contains four of a kind" and "contains yacht" and you can get some +points dices as well as the "+100 points when happy" dice. The strat works incredibly well because the +mult dices give a lot of happy twos.[/spoiler] Overall a nice and somewhat short game. Can only recommend if you like gambling without losing money.

A game that requires much luck to win and some bit of skill. The only way to pretty much win this game is to get consitently lucky with your rolls, dice, and effects. Still an okay game but the reliance on luck makes it less fun to play. The story is just there to explain why you are in this predicament to begin with but it doesn't really go any further than that. Maybe there could've been dialoque in the middle of gameplay from when they get mad or something. It kinda felt like the girl was just there to hook in people to the game. Overall, not bad, it's kinda similar to balatro with its multiplier and effects but just with dice instead of cards.

骰子得玩 韩国工作室做的免费游戏，故无中文仅英文&韩文。由于游戏规则初始讲得很清楚了且图鉴描述简洁，故语言并不是问题。游戏剧情则是和一个陌生女孩困在室内，需要掷骰子在每天达成规定分数，坚持15天从而逃出。本质上是个掷骰子形式的Rougelike——每天结束后，通过选择不同buff的骰子，进行点数搭配，形成一套体系，然后掷出自己需要的组合，最终达成目标分数。 作为一个Rougelike，这个游戏吃运气的地方主要有两处：第一是每日结束后的选择骰子(经典D牌环节)，由于每日结束刷新次数和该天剩余轮数有关，剩余轮数少了刷新次数也就少了，故运气不好的时候更难刷出体系需要的骰子从而陷入恶性循环；其次是掷骰子的时候，经常会发生投的结果跟上一轮一样或者骰子一偏想要的数字没了。前14天体系成了很容易打出来，然而第15天由于需要转换情绪，直接杀死了很多体系，加大了通关难度。 此外该游戏并没有骰子图鉴需要自己在游戏里摸索，所以我自己写了一篇指南，希望能有所帮助。
